title: messaging: the administrator's Slack link list answers at most 10,000 links — page GET /api/v1/messaging/slack/links
body:
repo:objectstack#4 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4czKnDE6hsyXQzB9wB2

Filing gate: seat contract delta N1 on PR #35789 (record 7040887222), the step-3 follow-up named in that PR's Scope out. ⛔ Not a claim.

**What.** After #35789, `GET /api/v1/messaging/slack/links` (an organization administrator's list of the people linked to the organization's Slack install) reads the install's links in one query capped at 10,000 rows and answers no paging. An organization with more links than that sees a silently shortened list. The removals do not depend on it: one link is read by its id and install, and the uninstall already reads every link in pages in id order.

**Ask.** Page the list: accept the platform's usual paging parameters (or an id cursor, as the uninstall reads), answer the page envelope the other list doors use, and drop the silent cap. Pin: an install with more links than one page lists every link across pages, and no page repeats or skips a link.

Goes with #34730 step 3 (the settings page UI that reads this list).
Blocked-by: #35789.
Suggested-grade: p3 · only organizations with more than 10,000 linked people.
Dedupe: `slack/links` (3 hits: #35810, #34730, #6015; none covers paging), `slack link paging` (searched before filing).
